name: three_createWorld_wrapper_conservative_instancing_v2
description: Conservatively rewrites modules exporting createWorld(THREE, scene) into a wrapper that preserves the original factory and update logic, then batches compatible repeated opaque THREE.Mesh children under the same parent into THREE.InstancedMesh. It keeps original mesh objects for animation/update references, removes those meshes from the rendered parent to avoid double rendering, stores stable semantic identities from userData.semanticId or name on the instanced mesh, and patches raycast results so instanceId maps back to the original semantic identity. It computes each instance matrix from the original mesh local matrix relative to the shared parent both at initialization and after every update, preserving nested moving parent groups and original animation formulas. It skips unsupported source shapes and never edits package/build/test/SDK files.
